messages:
maria: Heads-up: after the v8.2 rollout we saw a p99 increase from ~110ms -> ~420ms on the inference pool. KV cache hit rate dropped from 78% -> 42% around 12:31 UTC.
jon: seeing same on host gpu-12, qps steady but the tail jumped. :grimacing: 
maria: quick hypothesis: tokenizer change in v8.2 increased subtoken splits -> heavier seq-length tail; batcher ends up waiting for actor handshake which causes build-up and forces kernel selector into a slower path.
akshay: do we have profiler traces or flamegraphs? kernel_decider could be mis-evaluating when seq distribution shifts.
maria: pasting a short profiler snippet captured at spike time:
```
[00:12:31] batcher: queued_actors=23 handshake_wait=17ms avg_batch=8
[00:12:31] kernel_decider: chosen=quant_fast fallback=fp16_cost=1.9 decision_time=34ms
[00:12:31] kv_cache: hits=42 misses=58 evict_count=12
[00:12:31] actor: drop_handshake count=5 host=gpu-12
```
lee: `handshake_wait=17ms` is way above normal (<2ms). kernel_decider decision_time 34ms is also a visible scheduler spike.
jon: digging logs: repeated `actor 0x7ff drop_handshake timeout` on gpu-12 starting at 12:29:42.
akshay: sounds like batching heuristic waits longer when seqlen variance is high; interleaving short+long requests can stall actor groups and cause backpressure.
maria: repro plan: run mixed seqlen traffic v8.1 vs v8.2 on a small canary to reproduce the distribution shift. I can push canary to a rack.
deploy-bot: started canary rollout to rack-7 (2 hosts) at 12:45 UTC per request from maria.
lee: quick experiment: can we flip `runtime.kernel.decider.force_fallback=true` to force faster fp16 fallback path and see if latency improves?
jon: toggled flag on rack-7; canary p99 dropped back to ~120ms within 20s. :thumbsup:
akshay: KV hit rate on canary improved from 42% -> 70% after forcing fallback, which suggests the tokenizer changes are changing token boundaries and creating KV mismatches / cache fragmentation.
maria: action items: 1) pause full rollout for v8.2, 2) roll back tokenizer change on remaining hosts, 3) instrument actor<->batcher handshake latencies and emit histogram telemetry, 4) add seq-len distribution unit tests for kernel_decider heuristics.
lee: also file a perf-regression ticket and tag the model rollout as `v8.2-tokenizer-compat`.
jon: I'll attach full logs + flamegraph to the ticket and the canary comparison CSV.
akshay: I'll open a PR to emit sequence-length histogram and handshake_wait metric in runtime telemetry.
maria: thanks all — I'll coordinate the rollback and follow up with a short postmortem once we have rollback + metrics. :pray:
